entities.name: Holocaust Memorial Center for the Jews of Macedonia
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Holocaust Memorial Center for the Jews of Macedonia is a memorial to the Holocaust of the 7,148 Jews from North Macedonia and the history of the Jews in the Balkans, located in Skopje, the capital city of North Macedonia.
